newsitem.title: LEBANON: SLA militiamen, Israeli soldier hurt in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: SLA militiamen, Israeli soldier hurt in Lebanon.

text.p: Four pro-Israeli militiamen and an Israeli soldier were wounded on Monday when Hizbollah guerrillas attacked their outpost in Lebanon, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
Later, Israeli warplanes struck twice in the area facing the outpost, firing a total of six rockets into suspected Hizbollah bases in the hills of Sojoud and Akmata, Lebanese security sources said.

The South Lebanon Army militiamen and the Israeli soldier were injured in fighting with Hizbollah guerrillas who stormed into the outpost of Sojoud on the edge of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, the pro-Israeli sources added.
They said two Hizbollah guerrillas were killed near the sand bags at the entrance of the outpost after planting their flags on the position.
In Beirut, Hizbollah said they had no information on guerrilla casualties.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air attacks.
Hizbollah guerrillas regularly attack Israeli troops trying to oust them from the south Lebanon occupation zone, which Israel says protects its northern border.
